question: Estimate the reach of an Instagram campaign targeting Indian college students with a ₹50 lakh budget.
idealClarificationQuestions: Reach = unique users who see the ad at least once (vs impressions which can be repeated)? Yes — unique users.
Format: Reels-heavy or feed/stories mix? Assume blended (Meta auto-placements).
Targeting: 18-24 age, college-going, Tier 1+2 cities? Yes.

calculationFlow: Indian college student Instagram users (18-24, urban + Tier 2): ~80M MAU.
Average CPM (Cost Per Mille) for Indian college student targeting on Meta in 2026: ~₹70-90 (rising due to ad load saturation; was ₹40-50 in 2022).
Unique reach: 6.25 cr / 3.5 = ~1.8 crore unique users.
But this can't exceed addressable TAM (80M college students). 1.8 crore is ~22% of TAM — feasible.
Round: ~1.7-1.9 crore unique college students reached.
